name: textarea
title: Textarea
description: A multi-line text field that grows with its content instead of a script.
docs: ## When to use - A sentence or a paragraph: a comment, a description, a commit message, a note. - A field where the user's text is longer than the visible box should be. - Anywhere the browser's native resize handle is useful. ## When not to use - A single line (email, name, slug); use `input`. - Rich text. A `textarea` holds plain text; formatting needs an editor, which is out of scope for this library. - A value that must stay fixed in height; a `textarea` grows, and a fixed box hides the overflow from the user. ## Installation ```bash npx shadcn@latest add @cadence/textarea ``` ## Usage ```tsx import { Label } from "@/components/cadence/label/label"; import { Textarea } from "@/components/cadence/textarea/textarea"; export function Comment() { return (
